description.value: Rosalinda's is a family diner in downtown Vernon serving all-day breakfast and lunch with a Filipino-Canadian twist — think Pancit Noodles and Mano Dino Burger alongside classic Eggs Benny and French Toast. Home-baked bread, buns, desserts, and pastries are made in-house. It's a welcoming neighbourhood spot steps from Polson Park and within reach of Kalamalka and Ellison Provincial Park trails.
